preconditions.description: The number of strings n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The integer k is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(a_i) for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each string in the array a has a length of at least 1.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for a_i in a for c in a_i)
preconditions.description: Each character in the strings of the array a is a lowercase English letter.
The total length of all strings in the array a does not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output is a list of n integers, one for each string in the input array a.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in result)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x for x in result)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output list is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(x == sum(any(substring in a_j for a_j in a) >= k for substring in (a_i[l:r+1] for l in range(len(a_i)) for r in range(l, len(a_i)))) for i, a_i in enumerate(a) for x in [result[i]])
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output list represents the number of substrings of the corresponding string in the input array that appear in at least k strings of the array.
